place.en: The River Lord's shrine · The Zhang stands up

setup.zh: 漳水忽然停了——跟着一整条河从河床上立了起来。水墙正中浮上来一个人影，脚底下踩着两条青龙。岸上几千个人一齐跪下；你没跪。
setup.en: The Zhang suddenly stops — and then the whole river stands up from its bed. From the middle of the wall of water a figure rises, two blue dragons under its feet. Thousands on the bank kneel as one; you do not.

recap.zh: 漳水立起，河伯踩着两条青龙从水墙里升起来；两条龙试了那个不跪的人——他不避，张开两只手挡在了豆腐西施前头。上游柳荫里，一个老井嗓子的白衣人，看见了他掌心的印。
recap.en: The Zhang stood up and the River Lord rose from the wall of water on two blue dragons; the dragons tested the one who would not kneel — he did not step aside, and stood with both hands spread in front of the Tofu Beauty. In the willow shade upstream, a man in white with an old-well voice saw the mark in his palm.

zh: 几千个人跪下。一个人没跪。

story.zh:
小满本来以为，事情就到这里了。

哪知漳水忽然停了。不是退，是停：河面上的浪一道一道，全悬在了半空，一滴也不落下来。岸上几千个人，一齐闭上了嘴。

话音未落，漳水竟站了起来。不是涨，是站——一整条河从河床上立起来，立成了一道墙。

小满数了数，二十只船。二十件嫁衣。

岸上几千个人，一齐跪了下去。三老跪着，巫祝瘫着，豆腐西施站在岸边，瞪大了眼睛。小满没跪。他两条腿早软了，可他没跪，只死死攥着胸口的木牌，那木牌烫得他手心发疼。

几千个人里，站着的只有三个。一个是豆腐西施，她是哑巴，跪下去也喊不出冤，便索性不跪；一个远远地在上游那排老柳树底下，一身白衣，瞧不清脸，腰里悬着一柄剑；还有一个，便是沈小满。

那柳树底下，其实还有一个人。他也穿白，站在佩剑的那一个身后半步，站在柳荫最深的地方，岸上的人跪着，瞧不见他；小满站着，瞧见了。

河伯脚下，左边那条龙动了。
story.en:
Xiaoman had thought that was the end of it.

But the Zhang suddenly stopped. Not ebbed — stopped: wave after wave hung in the air over the river, not a drop falling. Thousands on the bank shut their mouths at once.

Before the words were out, the Zhang stood up. Not rose — stood: the whole river stood up from its bed into a wall.

Xiaoman counted: twenty boats. Twenty bridal gowns.

Thousands on the bank went down on their knees together. The Three Elders knelt, the shaman lay limp, the Tofu Beauty stood at the water's edge with her eyes wide. Xiaoman did not kneel. His legs had long since gone weak, but he did not kneel; he only gripped the token at his chest, so hot it hurt his palm.

Of all those thousands, only three were standing. One was the Tofu Beauty — mute, she could not cry out her wrong on her knees either, so she simply did not kneel; one stood far off under the old willows upstream, all in white, face unclear, a sword at his waist; and the third was Shen Xiaoman.

Under those willows there was in fact someone else. He too wore white, half a step behind the one with the sword, in the deepest of the willow shade; the kneeling crowd could not see him; Xiaoman, standing, could.

Under the River Lord's feet, the left-hand dragon moved.

exits.means: stands his ground and faces the two dragons' test without showing his Foundation

withdrawn.zh: 两条龙一扑一扫，都落了空，升回河伯脚下。它们还在等。
withdrawn.en: The dragons lunge and sweep and miss, and rise back to the River Lord's feet. They are still waiting.

story.zh:
小满喘着气，心里却已算明白了：它们不是来杀他的。真要杀，头一扑他便没了。这是在试。可试什么？试他跑得快不快，还是试他——

他没来得及想完。两条龙一齐动了。这一回它们不冲他，是从他两边绕过去，一左一右，直扑他身后的河岸。豆腐西施站在那里，站在一群跪着的人前头，嫁衣还穿在身上，一双眼睛睁得大大的，动也不动。

小满只要往旁边让一步，这一扑便与他不相干了。他的腿想让。他娘说过，打不过就跑，跑不丢人。可他这一回没让。他往后退了两步，退到豆腐西施跟前，转过身来，背对着她，两条胳膊一张，挡在了两条龙的正中间。

两只手掌张开着，掌心朝外。缠手的那条布，方才下水拖巫祝的时候，早叫漳水冲走了。

他什么本事也没使。他只是站在那里，泥从头发上一滴一滴往下掉，两个腿肚子在抖，抖得岸上的人都瞧得见。

他听见自己的声音，抖得不成样子，却一个字一个字地说出来了：「……她是卖豆腐的。她没招谁。」

两条龙瞧着他，龙须在风里一飘一飘。然后左边那条把鼻子凑过来，在他脑门上轻轻碰了一下，凉的，像腊月里的井水；跟着便收回头去，右边那条也跟着退了。它们缓缓升回半空，回到河伯脚下，盘好了，一动也不动了。

胸口的木牌凉了一凉，银月低低地道：「……傻子。」隔了一会儿，又道：「藏得倒还凑合。」

上游柳树底下，柳荫最深的那一条影子，往前走了一步。日头照在他脸上，四十来岁，面目寻常。他的眼睛没有看龙，也没有看河伯，看的是小满那两只张开的手。一只掌心里，一个圈，圈里一横。他看了一眼，便退回了柳荫里去。
story.en:
Panting, Xiaoman had already worked it out: they had not come to kill him. If they meant to, he'd have been gone at the first lunge. This was a test. But a test of what? Of how fast he ran, or of—

He never finished the thought. Both dragons moved at once. This time they did not come at him; they swung round him on either side, left and right, straight for the bank behind him. The Tofu Beauty stood there, in front of a crowd of kneeling people, still in her bridal clothes, eyes wide, not moving.

Xiaoman had only to take one step aside and this lunge would be none of his business. His legs wanted to. His mother had said: if you can't win, run; there's no shame in running. But this time he did not step aside. He backed two steps, right up to the Tofu Beauty, turned round with his back to her, flung out both arms, and stood square between the two dragons.

Both hands were spread open, palms out. The cloth round his hand had been washed away by the Zhang when he went in after the shaman.

He used no power at all. He only stood there, mud dripping from his hair drop by drop, both calves shaking so hard the whole bank could see it.

He heard his own voice, shaking to pieces, but getting it out word by word: "…She sells tofu. She never did anyone any harm."

The two dragons looked at him, their whiskers drifting in the wind. Then the left one brought its nose close and touched his forehead lightly — cold, like well water in the last month of winter — and drew its head back, and the right one withdrew with it. They rose slowly back into the air, back to the River Lord's feet, coiled up, and did not move again.

The token at his chest cooled a little, and Yinyue said low: "…Fool." After a moment: "The hiding wasn't bad, though."

Upstream under the willows, the figure in the deepest shade took one step forward. The sun fell on his face: forty or so, ordinary. His eyes were not on the dragons, nor on the River Lord, but on Xiaoman's two spread hands. In one palm, a circle with a bar inside it. He looked once, and stepped back into the shade.

exits.means: kneels like everyone else, gives in

text.zh: 你膝盖一软，又站直了。身后，豆腐西施没有跪。
text.en: Your knees give — and you straighten again. Behind you, the Tofu Beauty has not knelt.
